value.rationale: The indicator of 2-vertex-connected graphs is a natural network-robustness family. The low-degree incidence certificate reduces two million potentially zero signed sums to nine small graph-pattern counts, settles exact invertibility and its sharp 1/8 inverse stability at seven vertices, and distinguishes constrained-graph recovery from previously enumerated total counts. The result is a motivated complete finite classification with no higher-order extrapolation.
